data.narrative:
Periodic Labs is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Liam Fedus and Ekin Dogus Cubuk, having raised $300M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of one public peer (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private companies in the AI & Software sector, including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach, treating the $300M in total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in this sector. This yields an implied valuation of $750M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient narrow peer comparables; while 12 same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage and valuation tier produced fewer than three datapoints needed for reliable median triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $638M to $862M, centered on $750M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company and stage transition, the representativeness of using total raised as a valuation proxy, and the lack of narrower peer validation. The single-method triangulation limits conviction; validation through peer multiples or revenue-based approaches would strengthen the assessment once sufficient comparable data becomes available.
